title: Isotonic surrogate modeling for computer experiments with many input variables
summary: Virtual simulators are widely used for studying complex physical phenomena, from particle collisions to rocket propulsion. Such "computer experiments" can be highly time-intensive, and a Bayesian surrogate model can be used for efficient emulation with reliable uncertainty quantification. To train accurate surrogates with a limited sample size $n$, recent work has explored the incorporation of monotonicity (or isotonicity) information, which can often be elicited from physical systems.
